lines.text: Earth has more trees than our galaxy has stars.
And that's not even the weird part.

scene.label: THAT'S NOT EVEN THE WEIRD PART

lines.text: The Milky Way has about one hundred to four hundred billion stars.
lines.caption: The Milky Way has about 100 to 400 billion stars.

lines.text: Earth has around three trillion trees.
lines.caption: Earth has around 3 trillion trees.

lines.text: That's four hundred and twenty-two trees for every person alive.
lines.caption: That's 422 trees for every person alive.

lines.text: The weird part? Before humans started farming, there were almost twice as many.
